_about: Complete tracked-artifact publication inventory for PMI, one entry per tracked file (or per explicitly enumerated file group). Answers, for every artifact: origin, raw/derived, whether it is needed for the promised L1 reproduction, whether it carries player- or source-level content, the proposed public/private disposition, and why. PROPOSED dispositions are recommendations only: the operator makes the legal and publication decision (gate G1). Nothing here grants or implies a right to redistribute third-party content.
paper: Ratings Are Not Forecasts: Accounting, Calibration, and Information Timing in NBA Player-Impact Forecasting
